Two scripts, because I could not decide which gesture reads better on a wall.

```js
function setup() { createCanvas(800, 600); noLoop(); }
function draw() { background(20); circle(mouseX, mouseY, 40); }
function mousePressed() { redraw(); }
```

```ghost
[
  {"t": 300, "type": "move", "x": 0.25, "y": 0.25},
  {"t": 700, "type": "click", "x": 0.25, "y": 0.25}
]
```

Or this one, if you would rather it wandered:

```ghost
[
  {"t": 300, "type": "move", "x": 0.75, "y": 0.75}
]
```

## Statement

A dot that goes where it is told and nowhere else.
